name: cg_coin_market_chart
description:
Historical price, market cap and total volume series for one coin over the last N days, from CoinGecko (coins/{id}/market_chart).
Returns {prices: [[timestamp_ms, price]], market_caps: [[timestamp_ms, value]], total_volumes: [[timestamp_ms, value]]}; CoinGecko picks the granularity from the span (finer for short spans, daily for long ones).
Inputs (* required): id* (string, CoinGecko coin id such as bitcoin or ethereum, not the ticker symbol; ids come from cg_search or cg_coin_list), days (integer, look-back in days; default 30), vs (string, quote currency; default usd).
For candles use cg_coin_ohlc; for one past date cg_coin_history; for the current price cg_coin_price.
Example: {"id": "ethereum", "days": 90, "vs": "usd"}

id.description: CoinGecko coin id (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum), not the ticker symbol

vs.description: Quote currency code (e.g. usd, eur, btc)
